description: Splendor Hotel Taichung is a premier conference hotel in the heart of Taichung, Taiwan, offering modern meeting facilities alongside easy access to the city's cultural and business districts.
transportation: Located in central Taichung, within easy reach of Taichung HSR Station by shuttle or taxi, and close to Taichung Chiang Kai-Shek Memorial Park and the National Museum of Natural Science. Taichung International Airport is approximately 30 minutes away by car.
